finding.hypothesis: N-HEADROOM: cyclic Node<->parent/tree garbage awaits the collector because gc gen0 threshold is 40000 (tuning.py:11); not a leak
finding.refute_if: growth continues over the extra cycles after forced gc

note: Per-request Tree/Node graph is parent<->child cyclic, freed only by the cycle collector. tuning.py raises gc gen0 threshold to 40000, so garbage piles up between collections (sawtooth ~34k gc objects vs ~15k at default threshold; RSS ~22.7MB vs ~16.3MB). After forced gc the memory plateaus (alloc-test favors non-leak). Repair class: restore default threshold / break cycles on completion (weakref parent, or clear tree), not a leak fix.

remedy: N-HEADROOM supported by alloc-test E13 (favors non-leak) but ledger cannot confirm a sibling; verify by running production with gc threshold removed from tuning.py and watching RSS
